text: Before you trust any AI visibility tracker, ask whether it reports by buyer question or only as one blended score. Ask what happens to a question's history when the list of tracked questions changes. Ask whether a reading labelled day 7 was really taken on day 7. Ask how a before-and-after comparison is protected when the measuring method changes. Ask whether the tool ever states that a page caused a change, and on what basis. Ask whether a percentage on the report comes with the number of answers behind it. Ask what the report shows when a reading could not be taken, and whether a blank can be mistaken for a zero.
